lines.plain: You will hear a man talking about his holiday.
lines.kana: You will hear a man talking about his holiday.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士談他的假期。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about his holiday.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位男士谈他的假期。

t: Next summer we're going to Italy. We're going to stay for two weeks.
lines.plain: Next summer we're going to Italy. We're going to stay for two weeks.
lines.kana: Next summer we're going to Italy. We're going to stay for two weeks.
lines.zh: 明年夏天我們要去義大利，要待兩個星期。
lines.en: Next summer we're going to Italy. We're going to stay for two weeks.
lines.zh-Hans: 明年夏天我们要去意大利，要待两个星期。

t: How long will they stay in Italy?
ask.plain: How long will they stay in Italy?
ask.zh: 他們會在義大利待多久？
ask.en: How long will they stay in Italy?
ask.zh-Hans: 他们会在意大利待多久？

t: You will hear a boy asking his teacher a question.
lines.plain: You will hear a boy asking his teacher a question.
lines.kana: You will hear a boy asking his teacher a question.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩問老師問題。
lines.en: You will hear a boy asking his teacher a question.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一个男孩问老师问题。

t: Excuse me, Miss Hall. I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow one, please?
lines.plain: Excuse me, Miss Hall. I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow one, please?
lines.kana: Excuse me, Miss Hall. I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow one, please?
lines.zh: 霍爾老師，不好意思，我找不到我的鉛筆。可以借我一枝嗎？
lines.en: Excuse me, Miss Hall. I can't find my pencil. Can I borrow one, please?
lines.zh-Hans: 霍尔老师，不好意思，我找不到我的铅笔。可以借我一枝吗？

lines.plain: What's the weather like today?
lines.kana: What's the weather like today?
lines.zh: 今天天氣怎麼樣？
lines.en: What's the weather like today?
lines.zh-Hans: 今天天气怎么样？
lines.ja: 今日の天気はどうですか？

lines.plain: It's raining. Take your umbrella!
lines.kana: It's raining. Take your umbrella!
lines.zh: 在下雨。帶傘！
lines.en: It's raining. Take your umbrella!
lines.zh-Hans: 在下雨。带伞！

lines.plain: What's for dinner, Mum?
lines.kana: What's for dinner, Mum?
lines.zh: 媽，晚餐吃什麼？
lines.en: What's for dinner, Mum?
lines.zh-Hans: 妈，晚餐吃什么？

t: Chicken and rice. We had pizza yesterday.
lines.plain: Chicken and rice. We had pizza yesterday.
lines.kana: Chicken and rice. We had pizza yesterday.
lines.zh: 雞肉飯。昨天吃過披薩了。
lines.en: Chicken and rice. We had pizza yesterday.
lines.zh-Hans: 鸡肉饭。昨天吃过披萨了。

lines.plain: What does your mum do?
lines.kana: What does your mum do?
lines.zh: 你媽媽做什麼工作？
lines.en: What does your mum do?
lines.zh-Hans: 你妈妈做什么工作？

t: She's a teacher at my school. She teaches maths.
lines.plain: She's a teacher at my school. She teaches maths.
lines.kana: She's a teacher at my school. She teaches maths.
lines.zh: 她是我們學校的老師，教數學。
lines.en: She's a teacher at my school. She teaches maths.
lines.zh-Hans: 她是我们学校的老师，教数学。

lines.plain: Can you play an instrument?
lines.kana: Can you play an instrument?
lines.zh: 妳會樂器嗎？
lines.en: Can you play an instrument?
lines.zh-Hans: 妳会乐器吗？

t: Yes, I play the piano. I want to learn the guitar too.
lines.plain: Yes, I play the piano. I want to learn the guitar too.
lines.kana: Yes, I play the piano. I want to learn the guitar too.
lines.zh: 會，我彈鋼琴。我也想學吉他。
lines.en: Yes, I play the piano. I want to learn the guitar too.
lines.zh-Hans: 会，我弹钢琴。我也想学吉他。

t: Where are you going this afternoon?
lines.plain: Where are you going this afternoon?
lines.kana: Where are you going this afternoon?
lines.zh: 你今天下午要去哪裡？
lines.en: Where are you going this afternoon?
lines.zh-Hans: 你今天下午要去哪里？

t: To the swimming pool with my brother.
lines.plain: To the swimming pool with my brother.
lines.kana: To the swimming pool with my brother.
lines.zh: 和哥哥去游泳池。
lines.en: To the swimming pool with my brother.
lines.zh-Hans: 和哥哥去游泳池。

t: You will hear a man talking about a new shop.
lines.plain: You will hear a man talking about a new shop.
lines.kana: You will hear a man talking about a new shop.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士介紹一家新商店。
lines.en: You will hear a man talking about a new shop.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位男士介绍一家新商店。

t: Come to our new bookshop in King Street! We open on Monday the fifth of May. We sell books for children and adults. On Saturdays there is a story time for children at eleven o'clock. Coffee costs two pounds in our café. Our phone number is 0161 496 0000.
lines.plain: Come to our new bookshop in King Street! We open on Monday the fifth of May. We sell books for children and adults. On Saturdays there is a story time for children at eleven o'clock. Coffee costs two pounds in our café. Our phone number is 0161 496 0000.
lines.kana: Come to our new bookshop in King Street! We open on Monday the fifth of May. We sell books for children and adults. On Saturdays there is a story time for children at eleven o'clock. Coffee costs two pounds in our café. Our phone number is 0161 496 0000.
lines.zh: 來國王街我們的新書店吧！我們五月五日星期一開幕，賣兒童和成人的書。每星期六十一點有兒童故事時間。我們咖啡館的咖啡兩英鎊。電話是 0161 496 0000。
lines.en: Come to our new bookshop in King Street! We open on Monday the fifth of May. We sell books for children and adults. On Saturdays there is a story time for children at eleven o'clock. Coffee costs two pounds in our café. Our phone number is 0161 496 0000.
lines.zh-Hans: 来国王街我们的新书店吧！我们五月五日星期一开幕，卖儿童和成人的书。每星期六十一点有儿童故事时间。我们咖啡馆的咖啡两英镑。电话是 0161 496 0000。

t: You will hear Kate talking to her friend Harry about a party.
lines.plain: You will hear Kate talking to her friend Harry about a party.
lines.kana: You will hear Kate talking to her friend Harry about a party.
lines.zh: 你會聽到凱特和朋友哈利談一場派對。
lines.en: You will hear Kate talking to her friend Harry about a party.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到凯特和朋友哈利谈一场派对。

t: Hi Kate. Are you coming to Jake's party?
lines.plain: Hi Kate. Are you coming to Jake's party?
lines.kana: Hi Kate. Are you coming to Jake's party?
lines.zh: 嗨，凱特。妳要去傑克的派對嗎？
lines.en: Hi Kate. Are you coming to Jake's party?
lines.zh-Hans: 嗨，凯特。妳要去杰克的派对吗？

t: Yes! It's on Saturday, isn't it?
lines.plain: Yes! It's on Saturday, isn't it?
lines.kana: Yes! It's on Saturday, isn't it?
lines.zh: 要！是星期六對吧？
lines.en: Yes! It's on Saturday, isn't it?
lines.zh-Hans: 要！是星期六对吧？

t: Yes, at seven o'clock, at his house. Everyone is going to wear something blue.
lines.plain: Yes, at seven o'clock, at his house. Everyone is going to wear something blue.
lines.kana: Yes, at seven o'clock, at his house. Everyone is going to wear something blue.
lines.zh: 對，七點，在他家。大家都要穿藍色的衣服。
lines.en: Yes, at seven o'clock, at his house. Everyone is going to wear something blue.
lines.zh-Hans: 对，七点，在他家。大家都要穿蓝色的衣服。

t: Oh! I've got a blue dress. What are you going to give Jake?
lines.plain: Oh! I've got a blue dress. What are you going to give Jake?
lines.kana: Oh! I've got a blue dress. What are you going to give Jake?
lines.zh: 喔！我有一件藍色洋裝。你要送傑克什麼？
lines.en: Oh! I've got a blue dress. What are you going to give Jake?
lines.zh-Hans: 喔！我有一件蓝色洋装。你要送杰克什么？

t: A football. He loves football. And you?
lines.plain: A football. He loves football. And you?
lines.kana: A football. He loves football. And you?
lines.zh: 一顆足球。他很愛足球。妳呢？
lines.en: A football. He loves football. And you?
lines.zh-Hans: 一颗足球。他很爱足球。妳呢？

t: I'm going to make him a card and buy some chocolate.
lines.plain: I'm going to make him a card and buy some chocolate.
lines.kana: I'm going to make him a card and buy some chocolate.
lines.zh: 我要做一張卡片給他，再買一些巧克力。
lines.en: I'm going to make him a card and buy some chocolate.
lines.zh-Hans: 我要做一张卡片给他，再买一些巧克力。

t: You will hear a girl talking about her bedroom.
lines.plain: You will hear a girl talking about her bedroom.
lines.kana: You will hear a girl talking about her bedroom.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的房間。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her bedroom.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一个女孩谈她的房间。

t: My bedroom is small, but I love it. The walls are green and I have a big window.
lines.plain: My bedroom is small, but I love it. The walls are green and I have a big window.
lines.kana: My bedroom is small, but I love it. The walls are green and I have a big window.
lines.zh: 我的房間很小，但我很喜歡。牆是綠色的，有一扇大窗戶。
lines.en: My bedroom is small, but I love it. The walls are green and I have a big window.
lines.zh-Hans: 我的房间很小，但我很喜欢。墙是绿色的，有一扇大窗户。

t: You will hear a man at a train station.
lines.plain: You will hear a man at a train station.
lines.kana: You will hear a man at a train station.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士在火車站。
lines.en: You will hear a man at a train station.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位男士在火车站。

t: A ticket to Oxford, please. Just one way. How much is that?
lines.plain: A ticket to Oxford, please. Just one way. How much is that?
lines.kana: A ticket to Oxford, please. Just one way. How much is that?
lines.zh: 請給我一張到牛津的票，單程。多少錢？
lines.en: A ticket to Oxford, please. Just one way. How much is that?
lines.zh-Hans: 请给我一张到牛津的票，单程。多少钱？

t: Where does the man want to go?
ask.plain: Where does the man want to go?
ask.en: Where does the man want to go?

t: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.
lines.plain: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.
lines.kana: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩談他的週末。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking about his weekend.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一个男孩谈他的周末。
lines.ja: ある男の子が週末について話しているのを聞くでしょう。
lines.ko: 한 소년이 자신의 주말에 대해 이야기하는 것을 듣게 될 것입니다.
lines.ru: Вы услышите, как мальчик рассказывает о своих выходных.
lines.fr: Vous allez entendre un garçon parler de son week-end.
lines.es: Escucharás a un chico hablando sobre su fin de semana.
lines.de: Du wirst einen Jungen hören, der über sein Wochenende spricht.

t: On Saturday I went to the park with my dog. On Sunday I visited my grandparents.
lines.plain: On Saturday I went to the park with my dog. On Sunday I visited my grandparents.
lines.kana: On Saturday I went to the park with my dog. On Sunday I visited my grandparents.
lines.zh: 星期六我帶狗去公園。星期天我去看爺爺奶奶。
lines.en: On Saturday I went to the park with my dog. On Sunday I visited my grandparents.
lines.zh-Hans: 星期六我带狗去公园。星期天我去看爷爷奶奶。

t: What did the boy do on Sunday?
ask.plain: What did the boy do on Sunday?
ask.en: What did the boy do on Sunday?

t: You will hear a woman talking to her son.
lines.plain: You will hear a woman talking to her son.
lines.kana: You will hear a woman talking to her son.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士和兒子說話。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking to her son.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位女士和儿子说话。

t: Tom, it's cold today. Wear your coat and your hat, please.
lines.plain: Tom, it's cold today. Wear your coat and your hat, please.
lines.kana: Tom, it's cold today. Wear your coat and your hat, please.
lines.zh: 湯姆，今天很冷。請穿外套、戴帽子。
lines.en: Tom, it's cold today. Wear your coat and your hat, please.
lines.zh-Hans: 汤姆，今天很冷。请穿外套、戴帽子。

t: You will hear a girl talking about her best friend.
lines.plain: You will hear a girl talking about her best friend.
lines.kana: You will hear a girl talking about her best friend.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她最好的朋友。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her best friend.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一个女孩谈她最好的朋友。

t: My best friend is Mia. She's tall and she has long black hair. She's very kind.
lines.plain: My best friend is Mia. She's tall and she has long black hair. She's very kind.
lines.kana: My best friend is Mia. She's tall and she has long black hair. She's very kind.
lines.zh: 我最好的朋友是米亞。她很高，有一頭黑色長髮，人很好。
lines.en: My best friend is Mia. She's tall and she has long black hair. She's very kind.
lines.zh-Hans: 我最好的朋友是米亚。她很高，有一头黑色长发，人很好。

ask.zh: 米亞的頭髮是什麼樣子？
ask.zh-Hans: 米亚的头发是什么样子？
